Team —

Quick note ahead of next week's QBR: product and GTM have converged around a slight reframe of our "North Star" narrative for H1 2027. The change is intentionally small (emphasis moves from raw feature velocity to predictable inference economics), but it has implications for role language in the org announcement and the OKR check-in slide we present to the execs.

As we pull the QBR deck together, I need two things from this group by end-of-day Friday (11/20):
- A one-paragraph suggested lead blurb that communicates the reframed North Star for inclusion on page 2. Keep it customer-facing and crisp.
- A confirmed role-map for any role-title language that will appear in the announcement (attach an editable file if possible).

I've attached the current one-pager draft and an initial role map (v1) for comments. Please add inline edits in Drive or reply here with suggested wording.

Why this matters: the new framing helps with sales conversations (cost predictability + performance) and aligns our upcoming Dedicated and Private product positioning. We want the leadership announcement to be clear about who owns the transition and what success looks like by Q2.

I'm copying Lauren for comms alignment. If anyone expects blockers (budgets, heads, or interlocks) flag them here today so we can escalate.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
